userEmail.description: Output only. Email address of the user to run workflow invocations under.

oauthConfig.description: Optional. OAuth configuration for end user authentication.

commitSha.description: The commit SHA for this commit log entry.

author.description: The commit author for this commit log entry.

commitMessage.description: The commit message for this commit log entry.

OperationMetadata.description: Represents the metadata of the long-running operation.

verb.description: Output only. Name of the verb executed by the operation.

cancelRequested.description: Output only. Identifies whether the user has requested cancellation of the operation. Operations that have been cancelled successfully have google.longrunning.Operation.error value with a google.rpc.Status.code of `1`, corresponding to `Code.CANCELLED`.

apiVersion.description: Output only. API version used to start the operation.

createTime.description: Output only. The time the operation was created.

endTime.description: Output only. The time the operation finished running.

target.description: Output only. Server-defined resource path for the target of the operation.

statusDetail.description: Output only. Human-readable status of the operation, if any.

ActionSqlDefinition.description: Definition of a SQL Data Preparation

query.description: The SQL query representing the data preparation steps. Formatted as a Pipe SQL query statement.

dependencyTargets.description: A list of actions that this action depends on.

disabled.description: Whether this action is disabled (i.e. should not be run).

parentAction.description: The parent action of this assertion. Only set if this assertion was automatically generated.

selectQuery.description: The SELECT query which must return zero rows in order for this assertion to succeed.

relationDescriptor.description: Descriptor for the assertion's automatically-generated view and its columns.

tags.description: Arbitrary, user-defined tags on this action.

Assertion.description: Represents an assertion upon a SQL query which is required return zero rows.

policy.description: REQUIRED: The complete policy to be applied to the `resource`. The size of the policy is limited to a few 10s of KB. An empty policy is a valid policy but certain Google Cloud services (such as Projects) might reject them.

permissions.description: A subset of `TestPermissionsRequest.permissions` that the caller is allowed.

TriggerEvaluationRecord.description: A record of an attempt to evaluate trigger conditions.

status.description: Output only. The status of the trigger evaluation. Success is indicated by a code of 0 (OK). Message will only be present if the status code is non-zero.

evaluationTime.description: Output only. The timestamp of this trigger evaluation attempt.

destinationContainingFolder.description: Optional. The name of the Folder, TeamFolder, or root location to move the Folder to. Can be in the format of: "" to move into the root User folder, `projects/*/locations/*/folders/*`, `projects/*/locations/*/teamFolders/*`

nextPageToken.description: A token, which can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.

unreachable.description: Locations which could not be reached.

iamPolicyName.description: The IAM policy name for the resource.

isActive.description: Whether the IAM policy encoded in this view is active.
